independent_rule: Independent baseline also serves as no-social ablation: match selected social width, layer count, learning rate and three seeds; select its stopping epoch on development only.
evaluation_rule: Select solely on 132877; refit all seven for selected best epoch; held-out evaluation once per final seed.
history_rule: 51 observed time points over 2 s; short history 11 points; no interpolation; segment break on gaps/track changes/jumps.
constant_velocity_rule: Least squares over last 11 actual samples, require 6 samples, cap 12 m/s; no future data.
uncertainty_rule: Optional isotropic Gaussian, temperature calibrated only on development; held-out radial coverage at 50/80/95 percent.
pass_subset_rule: BAS Pass within +/-25 frames of anchor; all observed players evaluated; BAS never model input.
